Dear Miss Yonge,
How do you like the enclosed title page?

If it suits your idea I am well pleased with it.[^1]
Yours very faithfully
[A.

Macmillan](../persons.html#939)

[^1]: Probably that for [Historical Selections](../books.html#71).
